summary: Design and validate production voice and chat AI agents, translating operational requirements into reliable conversation logic and repeatable QA workflows.
Build internal tools and reusable methods for agent testing, evidence capture and conversational-agent quality assurance.

details.overview: Design, implement and validate production conversational AI systems for voice and chat applications.
responsibilities: Design and maintain global prompts, conversation architecture, node-based flows, dynamic variables, guardrails, routing, escalation logic and response-control rules.
Build structured flows for qualification, follow-up, objection handling, callbacks, transfers, identity handling and failure recovery.
Define fallback behavior and conversation-state rules for changing inputs, incomplete information, silence and objections.
Optimize voice-agent behavior for TTS delivery, including pacing, pauses, pronunciation, punctuation handling and natural Mexican Spanish phrasing.
Run structured QA with test cases, edge-case coverage, stress scenarios, regression checks, call reviews and failure-mode analysis.
Use Cekura for conversational-agent testing, including personality-based scenarios and reviewed success/failure evidence.
Work with OpenAI API, Retell, LiveKit and Whisper across conversational AI development, testing and support workflows.
Support SIP/VoIP troubleshooting and provider coordination by reviewing call behavior, logs, trunk directionality and platform configuration.
achievements: Built an internal web-based agent tester with Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind and LiveKit for configuring variables, making web calls and exporting QA evidence.
Created validation for agent IDs and dynamic variables, including required-field, unknown-field and type checks.
Created the Conversational Agent Engineering (CAE) framework for reusable agent design, testing and documentation.
pdfHighlights: Design and maintain production voice and chat AI agents with prompt architecture, node-based flows, dynamic variables, guardrails, routing and escalation logic.
Run structured QA using test cases, edge cases, stress scenarios, regression checks, call reviews and failure-mode analysis; use Cekura for test evidence.
Built an internal Next.js/React agent tester for configuring dynamic variables, making web calls and exporting QA evidence.
